welcome-wms.title: Welcome to Warehouse Management System (WMS)
welcome-wms.description: WMS (Warehouse Management System) is an intelligent solution designed to optimize warehouse operations. It enhances logistics efficiency and accuracy through automated inventory management, real-time order processing, and intelligent storage layout. The system supports seamless integration with ERP, TMS, etc., enabling full supply chain collaboration to help enterprises reduce operational costs and improve customer satisfaction.
welcome-wms.download-description: Manage warehouse anytime, anywhere with more efficient mobile operations
welcome-wms.download-description-more: Break free from fixed workstations! The mobile APP allows real-time synchronization of warehouse dynamics. Complete inbound, outbound, transfer, and counting operations by scanning codes anywhere. Improve on-site efficiency for smarter, more flexible warehouse management!

tooltips.total: Total Inventory: Includes on-hand, damaged, returned, sorted, picked, and packed.
tooltips.received: Received: Quantity received but not yet sorted. Not included in total inventory calculation.
tooltips.asn: ASN Inventory: Pre-arrival notification confirmed but not physically arrived. Not included in current inventory calculation.
tooltips.dn: DN Inventory: Outbound order waiting for picking. Generated DN not yet picked. Excluded from current inventory calculation.
tooltips.low-threshold: Low threshold: Triggers restock request when inventory falls below this level.
tooltips.high-threshold: High threshold: Triggers clearance request when inventory exceeds this level.
tooltips.available: Available Stock: Current stock quantity ready for use (includes physical on-hand + damaged + returned items), excluding locked and pending outbound inventory.
tooltips.sale: Sellable Stock: Current stock quantity available for sale, excluding locked and pending outbound inventory.

workflow.step2: Create the shipment: preferably click “Create FedEx Shipment” on the DN's export documents card (the tracking number is saved and the declared value is submitted automatically). If FedEx is unavailable, create it manually in the carrier's system (enter the declared value for carriage if shown) and get the tracking number (AWB)
workflow.step3: If created manually, save the tracking number on this page (already saved when created automatically)
workflow.step4: Issue and print the documents (CI / PL) on the DN, plus the shipping label if created automatically

carrier.title: Carrier Shipment

tips.disabled: Automatic FedEx shipment creation is not enabled (it can be enabled in the backend configuration). Create the shipment in the carrier's system and save the tracking number on the delivery task.
tips.auto: Uses the packages, customs lines and exporter profile on this page. The tracking number is saved to the delivery task automatically, and the CI / PL are re-issued with it. If FedEx is unavailable, create the shipment manually in the carrier's system and save the tracking number on the delivery task.
tips.creating: Creating the shipment in FedEx. This may take a few dozen seconds; please keep this page open…
tips.blocked: Cannot create the shipment automatically yet:
tips.timeout: FedEx timed out. The shipment may have been created in FedEx anyway. Check in FedEx Ship Manager before retrying to avoid a duplicate shipment.
tips.last-cancelled: The previous shipment {tracking} was cancelled at {time}
tips.label-open: Opens the label PDF in a new tab, where you can print or download it
tips.etd-submitted: The CI was submitted to FedEx as an Electronic Trade Document (ETD)
tips.declared-value-submitted: Declared value {amount} submitted with the shipment
tips.thermal-file: Thermal labels are printer command files ({type}). Open the file with the label printer's printing software to print it.
tips.send-to-printer-unavailable: Sending command files directly to the label printer is not connected yet. Download the label file and open it with the label printer's printing software.
tips.thermal-print: When printing, choose the label printer, paper size 100×150 mm and scale Actual size (100%)
tips.etd-enabled: Electronic Trade Documents (ETD) are enabled: the CI is submitted to FedEx electronically when the shipment is created.
tips.permission-denied: FedEx denied permission for this action. Check that the FedEx API project has the required API (e.g. Ship API) enabled.
tips.a4-print: When printing, choose A4 paper and scale Actual size (100%); for international shipments, also print the AWB copy pages. The label file is Letter size (about 6 mm wider than A4), so a slightly wider page or a margin warning in the print preview is normal; the label area is not cut off. Do not switch to Fit to page.
tips.auxiliary: The label PDF also contains FedEx AWB copy pages (FEDEX AWB COPY). Print all pages and follow the instructions on them.
tips.declared-value-submitted-capped: Declared value {amount} submitted with the shipment (the customs data has {original}, which exceeds the packed goods value, so it was adjusted automatically)

unresolved.title: The FedEx shipment result is unknown; a new shipment cannot be created yet
unresolved.description: WMS could not confirm the result of this shipment request. The shipment may have been created in FedEx. To avoid a duplicate shipment and duplicate charges, check in FedEx first.
unresolved.in-progress: A shipment for this DN is being created (possibly by someone else or from another screen). You cannot create another one until it finishes. This page refreshes automatically.
unresolved.step1: Sign in to FedEx Ship Manager and look up the shipment by the transaction ID or tracking number above, or by recipient and ship date
unresolved.step2: If you find it, cancel (void) the shipment in FedEx Ship Manager
unresolved.step3: Once you have confirmed that the shipment does not exist in FedEx or has been cancelled, click "Checked" to clear it, then create the shipment again
unresolved.dismiss-confirm: Confirm that you have checked in FedEx Ship Manager (transaction ID: {transaction}, tracking number: {tracking}) that the shipment does not exist in FedEx or has been cancelled manually. After clearing, you can create the shipment again; if the shipment actually still exists in FedEx, you will get a duplicate shipment and charges.
unresolved.dismissed: Cleared. You can create the shipment again.

reasons.compensation_failed: Created in FedEx, but saving it in WMS failed and the automatic cancellation also failed (the shipment very likely exists in FedEx)
reasons.bad_response: The FedEx response could not be understood
reasons.stale: The request has not finished for a long time (it may have been interrupted)
